Oil Module Principle: Oil functions as an abstract national resource alongside IPCs and does not require physical transportation.
Oil production is geographically located and territorial control can affect national supply.
Oil locations may be naturally active or require infrastructure development.
Land and offshore extraction may use different forms of infrastructure.
The Oil System must function as both an R&D-integrated module and a standalone vanilla Global 1940 expansion.
R&D may improve or expand the Oil System without being required for its basic operation.
